findings.title: A signature header with no v1 value skips verification
findings.trigger: POST /hooks/kestrel with the header 'Kestrel-Signature: t=<current time>' and any body.
findings.impact: The timestamp check passes, candidates is empty, and the mismatch check is skipped, so verify returns and a forged payment event is applied to the ledger. The base code rejected a missing v1; an empty candidate list has to fail.
